_comment: Simplified Chinese (Mainland China) texts for the German table fx. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.Both ears hear the same sound, for heari: 双耳听到相同的声音，方便单侧听力的玩家。
重击时画面晃动的程度。
strings.How strongly the phone or gamepad vibrat: 手机或手柄振动的强度。
strings.Important sounds also show as a short te: 重要的声音也会在画面顶部显示简短文字。
文字逐行出现时的短促提示音。
strings.Text voice and Spirling cries. Left and: 文字语音与Spirling的叫声。按左右键以10为单位调整。
风声、水声等地点的环境声音。按左右键以10为单位调整。
